simple.meaning: חֲבַל (chăbal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to ruin.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 6:12. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲבַל (H2255).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֲבַל (chăbal) / H2255 is traced through Ezra 6:12, Daniel 2:44, Daniel 4:20, Daniel 6:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.

timeline.evidenceText: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.

“In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.
The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;

Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

Dominion was given him, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which will not pass away, and his kingdom that which will not be destroyed.

definitions.full: H2255. chabal [ חֲבַל ] verb Pa`el destroy, hurt (see Biblical Hebrew II. חבל ); — Perfect 3masculine plural suffix חַבְּלוּנִי Dan 6:23 (of lions); Imperative masculine plural suffix חַבְּלוּהִי 4:20 (suffix of tree); Infinitive לְחַבָּלָה Ezra 6:12 (accusative of temple). Hithpa. be destroyed: Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּתְחַבַּל Dan 2:44 ; 6:27 ; 7:14 ( בַּ֑ל -; all of kingdom of God).
